expected_level_description: You can: - understand accessibility and that users have different accessibility needs - help fix accessibility issues under the direction of others
You can: - listen to the needs of design and business stakeholders and interpret information - take part in discussions within a multidisciplinary team
You can: - understand the work of others and the importance of team dynamics, collaboration and feedback
You can: - follow agreed good practice for the team - show an awareness of the importance of team dynamics and collaboration - understand the importance of feedback
You can: - explain the importance of using modern development standards
You can: - design, code, test, correct and document simple user interfaces using the right standards and tools under the direction of others
You can: - explain what prototyping is, and why and when to use it - understand how to work in an open and collaborative environment (by pair working, for example)
You can: - show an understanding of user experience analysis and its principles - explain the purpose of user stories and the focus on user needs
You can: - describe the basic principles of web performance - explain why web performance is important - help improve web performance under supervision
You can: - describe the main parts of the health and care system and the services the organisation supports - explain why patient safety and confidentiality matter in your work
You can: - explain how health IT systems can harm patients, for example through wrong, missing, or delayed information - report a possible clinical safety issue through the right route
You can: - follow the organisation's rules for handling personal and health information - recognise and report a data breach or near miss
